summary: A 1935 newspaper item puts a fire lookout on Ludden Peak; the cabin the registers record is on Dodger Point, so the link to Ludden is unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Identity is unresolved. The only source that places a lookout on Ludden Peak is the 1935 Oakland Tribune item quoted on the Washington Lookouts page. The registers and Wikipedia place a 1933 Forest Service cabin on Dodger Point, the easiest route to Ludden. A search summary claimed a listing paired the 1933 Dodger Point site with Ludden Peak; I could not verify that, and the Washington Lookouts pages list Dodger Point under Clallam County and Ludden Peak separately under Jefferson County. The counties also conflict: NHLR gives Challam County (a typo) for Dodger Point, and Wikipedia's Dodger Point article does not name a county in the sections read. The NRHP nomination for Dodger Point (No. 07000736) and any Olympic National Park historic building inventory may show whether a lookout ever stood on Ludden Peak. No correction proposed: the record's status is unknown and no separate Ludden Peak lookout was confirmed. The WTA Ludden Peak page gave no usable text. Page reads and searches went slightly over the brief's budget.
